title: Smooth ALE scalar-flat Kahler extension of the LeBrun metric on O(-n), n>=3, to nearby affine C-bundle fibres over CP1 in the specified transition family
author: Nobuhiro Honda
source_title: Scalar Flat Kähler Metrics on Affine Bundles over CP1
difficulty_reason: The construction identifies the real Kuranishi deformation space of a compactified twistor pair with the deformation space of a doubled Hirzebruch surface. Explicit tangent-sheaf cohomology and a real Kodaira-Spencer comparison show that the affine-bundle family supplies all the required nearby divisors, allowing the scalar-flat Kahler and ALE metric structures to persist smoothly.

statement_scope: Selected full n>=3 deformation branch of Theorem3.4: in A_n->C^(n-1) with transition zeta0=u^(-n)zeta1+sum_(l=1)^(n-1)t_l u^(-l), the LeBrun ALE scalar-flat Kahler metric on the central O(-n) fibre extends smoothly to all sufficiently nearby fibres. No global parameter-neighborhood size, low-degree n=1/2 or all-negative-degree corollary is selected.
